consumer: The GUI monster panel/sidebar that draws each visible monster's HP bar and asks 'what color band (green/yellow/red) should this bar display' from the hp/hp_max ratio.
scope: per-visible-monster display view: the engine's HP-fraction-to-color mapping for each monster the avatar can see, not raw integers and not a check
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities — its body writes only raw mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() integers (class S), so the GUI's green/yellow/red color-band mapping is NOT shown; the decisive color-banding routine (the display formatter that buckets the hp fraction into green/yellow/red) is absent from the excerpts and must be cited, not re-derived from a naive ratio.
divergence: A monster whose hp/hp_max lands exactly on a band boundary (e.g. the GUI shows yellow at that fraction but a naive >2/3 green / >1/3 yellow cut from the raw integers shows green): the raw-integer reconstruction colors the bar wrong while the engine's display mapping colors it correctly.
